Class SysMLEffect

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.occurrences.SysMLOccurrence
sysmlinjava.actions.SysMLAction
sysmlinjava.states.SysMLEffect
public final class SysMLEffect extends SysMLAction
SysMLinJava's representation of the SysML effect that specifies the optional behavior to be performed during transition between states or within a state. The SysMLEffect is performed within the context of the state machine in which it is declared, but has parameteric access to a specified context, which is typically the block for which the state machine operates.

Note the SysMLEffect cannot be extended and must be used as-is to specify a SysML effect for a transition. An example follows. 

@Effect
private SysMLEffectAction onEthernetIPPacketEffect;
@Effect
private SysMLEffectAction onDataLinkFrameEffect;
@Effect
private SysMLEffectAction onGPSMessageEffect;

        :
@Override
protected void createEffects()
{
        super.createEffects();
        onGPSMessageEffect = new SysMLEffect(context, onGPSMessageEffectActivity, "onGPSMessage");
        onEthernetIPPacketEffect = new SysMLEffect(context, onEthernetIPPacketEffectActivity, "onEthernetIPPacket");
        onDataLinkFrameEffect = new SysMLEffect(context, onDataLinkFrameEffectActivity, "onDataLinkFrame");
}

    • identityString

      public String identityString()
      Description copied from class: SysMLAnything
      Overridable operation for the identity String for this object for use in logging and other display outputs. This default implementation returns the object's name, if present, or the class's name if not. If the id is set to a value greater than 0, then the id is concatenated. (If the id is to be concatenated to the identity string, then set the id to an integer value greater than 0). If an array index value is present, the index (in square brackets) is concatenated to the string.

      Extensions of the SysMLAnything can override this operation to provide an arbitrarily formatted identity string as desired.

      Overrides:
